scope: Descriptive local phase sweep on the already evaluated JPL 2023 window.
phases: Translate all twelve base starts together by each integer hour r=0..8759 modulo 8760. Basis spacing is 730 hours, so r=0..729 represents 730 distinct sets, each repeated twelve times.
endpoint_rule: Keep all scoring and endpoint rules in the base protocol, including no synthetic interval across the dated data boundary.
score: For each lag d=12,24,36 compute S_d = (sum over twelve prime count gains from D - sum over twelve uniform count gains from D)/12.
strict_win: S_24 > max(S_12,S_36), strict. Report that count and, separately, how many also have positive prime gain and S_24>0 as in the base protocol.
raw_prime_comparison: As a secondary summary, count phases with prime gain at +24 strictly greater than at both +12 and +36, before adjusting for uniform gains.
SLog: Every pair, grid and reference crossing is recorded once per distinct phase, with its upward or downward direction, first hourly sample after the crossing, surrounding D/control sample brackets and four capture flags. Full-year aliases are recoverable by reindexing the twelve starts.
interpretation: Exact frequency under a uniform translation of the declared set in the fixed 2023 ephemeris. The distinct phases overlap in their data and are not independent yearly replications.
